scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a media binding id in the Unity manifest.

diagnostics.message: Unity media binding ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Bind media to a family outside Goal 047/055 families.

diagnostics.message: Family id must resolve to a selected source family.

scenarios.causalMutation: Bind media to a slot absent from Goal 055 staged files.

diagnostics.message: Slot id must resolve to a Goal 055 media slot.
Public GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Lua execution while producing media-bound Unity proof.

diagnostics.message: Lua execution is forbidden for Goal 056.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace staged PNG bytes with malformed data.

diagnostics.message: PNG files require valid signature, dimensions and CRC proof.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace staged WAV bytes with malformed data.

diagnostics.message: WAV files require a valid RIFF/WAVE PCM header and data chunk.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove Goal 055 staged media-bound package evidence.

diagnostics.message: Goal 055 media-bound review package source is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Stage media without Goal 055/054 review provenance.

diagnostics.message: Every staged file requires Goal 055/054 provenance trace.

scenarios.causalMutation: Delete a staged PNG after manifest creation.

diagnostics.message: Every family requires at least one staged PNG.

scenarios.causalMutation: Delete a staged WAV after manifest creation.

diagnostics.message: Every family requires at least one staged WAV.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Unity proof without a launch/play-loop log marker.

diagnostics.message: Unity media proof requires real launch or play-loop trace markers.

scenarios.causalMutation: Shuffle source, staged or manifest records.

diagnostics.message: Goal 056 records must be deterministically ordered.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, network, LLM or RAG execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Runtime or WinForms UI mutation.

diagnostics.message: Runtime and WinForms UI mutation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change a Goal 055 source artifact after Goal 056 source manifest records its hash.

diagnostics.message: Goal 055 source hashes must match physical artifacts.

scenarios.causalMutation: Load a Unity media file whose runtime hash differs from the manifest hash.

diagnostics.message: Unity media hash validation must pass for loaded files.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace the Unity Alpha runtime with a broad media browser/refactor.

diagnostics.message: Only a narrow media manifest loader/panel/log extension is allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use an absolute path or path traversal in the Unity manifest.

diagnostics.message: Unity media paths must be safe relative paths.
